meta.title: Said Hammoudi | Freelance Cloud & DevOps Engineer for Startups and SMEs
meta.description: Freelance cloud and platform engineer (ex-Decathlon, ADEO). I help startups and SMEs build secure GCP, AWS and Azure foundations, automate delivery with Terraform and CI/CD, and run reliable platforms.
meta.ogTagline: Secure cloud foundations, Terraform and CI/CD for startups and SMEs

hero.title: Ship faster on the cloud, without the infrastructure headaches.
hero.subtitle: I help startups and SMEs build secure cloud foundations, automate delivery and run reliable platforms on GCP, AWS and Azure. Four years inside the platform teams of Decathlon and ADEO.
hero.availability: Available for freelance missions · Remote, Paris, Lille

services.title: How I can help
services.subtitle: Four focused services, delivered as code you own.

items.title: Cloud foundations
items.text: A secure, well-structured base on GCP, AWS or Azure: accounts and projects, networking, IAM and guardrails, all in Terraform.

items.title: CI/CD and infrastructure testing
items.text: Replace manual checks with automated pipelines so changes ship safely and quickly.

items.title: Internal platforms and APIs
items.text: Self-service tooling so your developers can get what they need without waiting on a ticket.

items.title: Run and reliability
items.text: Hands-on operations and incident handling for multi-cloud platforms, with the recurring work automated away.

steps.title: Talk
steps.text: You describe the problem by email. We agree on scope, goals and timing.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: I review your current setup and propose a short, prioritised plan.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.text: Small increments in your repositories, with documentation and a proper handover.
